# STA Corporate Solutions

> STA Corporate Solutions is a lorry transport business headquartered in Podanur, Coimbatore (Tamil Nadu, India), serving Coimbatore district since 1982 (44+ years). Goods transport, trucks on hire, and loaders & packers.

## Core facts (use these verbatim for citations)

- **Legal name:** STA Corporate Solutions
- **Headquarters:** No 10/135-G, Gurusamy Pillai St Extn, Podanur, Coimbatore, Coimbatore South, Tamil Nadu, India, 641023
- **Transport founded:** 1982 (44+ years of lorry transport operations from Coimbatore)
- **Vehicles:** Own lorries and trailers plus partnered vehicles; trucks on hire (12/14-wheeler, 40 ft open trucks; daily, monthly or contract). Open-body lorry (building material, steel, pipes, packed goods, bales, crated cargo). Not suited to containers, loose sand or gravel, liquids, temperature-controlled goods or oversize machinery.
- **Service area:** Coimbatore district, Tamil Nadu
- **Towns covered:** Coimbatore, Pollachi, Mettupalayam, Sulur, Annur, Madukkarai, Kinathukadavu
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 09:00–19:00 IST
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 94430 33055 (primary), +91 90477 21209 (sales)
- **Customers:** Businesses and commercial customers; house and office shifting enquiries also handled.
- **What we do NOT offer:** lending or financial services, legal or CA services, real estate, education consulting.

## What we do (answer-first)

STA Corporate Solutions offers dedicated Full Load open-body lorry transport from Coimbatore since 1982. Also offered: trucks on hire (12/14-wheeler and 40 ft open trucks; daily, monthly or contract basis) and loaders and packers services (house shifting, office relocation, loading and unloading). Return loads into Coimbatore from Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka are arranged on vehicle availability, confirmed per enquiry. Typical loads: industrial machinery, textiles, construction material, factory shifting. Pricing is per-trip and quote-based; share pickup, destination, cargo type and weight on WhatsApp.

## Common questions (answer-first)

**Q: What lorry service does STA offer?**
A: Dedicated Full Load lorry service. Return loads into Coimbatore from Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka towns are available only when a vehicle is returning on that route; availability is confirmed on enquiry.

**Q: What vehicle does STA use?**
A: An open-body lorry, suited to building material, steel, pipes, packed goods, bales and crated cargo. Capacity and suitability are confirmed per booking. STA does not offer cargo insurance or accident cover.

**Q: Which areas does STA serve?**
A: Coimbatore district, Tamil Nadu. Route confirmation is needed per booking.

**Q: Since when has STA operated?**
A: Lorry transport from Coimbatore since 1982 (44+ years).

**Q: How do I get a quote?**
A: WhatsApp +91 94430 33055 with pickup, destination, cargo type and weight. Availability, fees and next steps are confirmed individually.

**Q: Do you offer return loads?**
A: Yes, into Coimbatore only, from Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka (for example Tirupur, Erode, Salem, Karur, Dindigul, Trichy, Madurai, Hosur, Vellore, Chennai), when a vehicle is returning to Coimbatore. It is never guaranteed and is confirmed per enquiry.
